description: This file defines and exports constants and modules related to a diagram or charting tool, including a 'diagram' module with functions for configuration, data handling, rendering, and theme management. It appears to be part of a larger visualization framework, likely for a quadrant chart, with complex parsing, rendering, and configuration logic.

methods.name: getDefaultData
methods.description: Returns default initial data for the diagram, including title, quadrant labels, axis texts, and points.

methods.name: getDefaultConfig
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings for the diagram, such as visibility of axes and title, sizes, paddings, font sizes, and positions.

methods.name: getDefaultThemeConfig
methods.description: Provides default theme colors for the different quadrants and points.
